title: ModernFix issue #565: incompatible with VMP-Forge

text:
[issue by dghodgson]
### Bug Description

Attempting to load Modernfix alongside VMP-Forge will cause the minecraft client to crash.

Tested with following versions:
- VMP mc1.20.1-0.2.0+beta.7.102-all
- Modernfix 5.23.0+mc1.20.1

Modernfix 5.18.0+mc1.20.1 seems to launch without any issues. All older versions tested failed with a different error than the one found in the attached log.

### Reproduction Steps

Install the following versions:
- VMP mc1.20.1-0.2.0+beta.7.102-all
- Modernfix 5.23.0+mc1.20.1

Forge: 47.4.1
